intent: 无缝循环的向上滚动背景（歌词 PV 用的循环滚动装置），内容用简单几何图案即可

iterations.critique: The rig works: full-frame coverage with no empty band, clear upward displacement of trackable motifs between t1 and t4 (~360px, matching 120px/s), and the mirror-tile joins show no tear. But the CONTENT misses '简单几何图案' — soft cloudy noise upscaled 125% reads mushy/organic, not crisp geometry.

Block noise turned the content into a crisp plum/cream pixel-mosaic — reads as geometric pattern now. Full-frame coverage with no gaps, mirror joins seamless, and with FN static (no evolution) the block arrangement differences between t1 and t4 are pure scroll displacement, consistent with the 120px/s upward rig verified in iter1. Loop-scroll device criteria met.
